title: Adding a warm-task option touches client, hook, host interface, saga, and TaskInput
answers: How to add a new option to warm cloud task
Which files change when warm task request gets a new field
Warm activation vs warm request mismatch
body:
A new launch option for warm cloud tasks (as `permissionMode` was) must change together:
- API client: `warmTask` options/body in products/desktop/packages/api-client/src/posthog-client.ts (send `?? null`) and the run-start/activation payload type (`initial_permission_mode?`) in the same file; update posthog-client.test.ts expected bodies.
- Hook: `UseWarmTaskOptions`/`useWarmTask` and `WarmTaskLeaseKeyParts` (ui/.../hooks).
- Host interface: `ITaskCreationHost.takeWarmTaskLease` in products/desktop/packages/core/src/task-detail/taskCreationHost.ts and impl `TrpcTaskCreationHost` in ui/.../taskCreationHostImpl.ts.
- Saga: `TaskCreationSaga` passes it to `takeWarmTaskLease` and to warm activation (gated on `workspaceMode === "cloud" && canActivateWarmRun && runtime !== "pi"`).
- UI: TaskInput.tsx passes it to `useWarmTask`.
- Adapter default must match everywhere: `adapter ?? "claude"` in both TaskInput and saga, else lease keys differ (null vs claude).
applies: Desktop warm task / cloud task creation code paths
